SELECT t1.TABLE_NAME, obj_description((quote_ident(t1.table_schema) || '.' || quote_ident(t1.table_name))::regclass, 'pg_class') AS TABLE_COMMENT, NULL AS TABLE_COLLATION, NULL AS ENGINE, NULL AS CREATE_TIME, CASE WHEN t2.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isConfigured FROM information_schema.tables t1 LEFT JOIN gen_table t2 ON t1.TABLE_NAME = t2.table_name WHERE t1.TABLE_SCHEMA = CURRENT_SCHEMA() AND t1.table_type = 'BASE TABLE'
AND t1.TABLE_NAME LIKE '%' || #{queryParams.keywords} || '%'
AND t1.TABLE_NAME NOT IN
#{excludeTable}
ORDER BY t1.TABLE_NAME

SELECT TABLE_NAME, obj_description((quote_ident(table_schema) || '.' || quote_ident(table_name))::regclass, 'pg_class') AS TABLE_COMMENT, NULL AS TABLE_COLLATION, NULL AS ENGINE, NULL AS CREATE_TIME FROM information_schema.tables WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = CURRENT_SCHEMA() AND TABLE_NAME = #{tableName}

SELECT c.COLUMN_NAME, c.DATA_TYPE, col_description((quote_ident(c.table_schema) || '.' || quote_ident(c.table_name))::regclass, c.ORDINAL_POSITION) AS COLUMN_COMMENT, CASE WHEN pk.COLUMN_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isPrimaryKey, c.IS_NULLABLE, c.CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH, NULL AS CHARACTER_SET_NAME, c.COLLATION_NAME FROM information_schema.columns c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT kcu.TABLE_SCHEMA, kcu.TABLE_NAME, kcu.COLUMN_NAME FROM information_schema.table_constraints tc JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage kcu ON tc.CONSTRAINT_NAME = kcu.CONSTRAINT_NAME AND tc.TABLE_SCHEMA = kcu.TABLE_SCHEMA AND tc.TABLE_NAME = kcu.TABLE_NAME WHERE tc.CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'PRIMARY KEY' AND tc.TABLE_SCHEMA = CURRENT_SCHEMA() ) pk ON c.TABLE_SCHEMA = pk.TABLE_SCHEMA AND c.TABLE_NAME = pk.TABLE_NAME AND c.COLUMN_NAME = pk.COLUMN_NAME WHERE c.TABLE_SCHEMA = CURRENT_SCHEMA() AND c.TABLE_NAME = #{tableName} ORDER BY c.ORDINAL_POSITION ASC
